# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Empirical-Lane Access, Execution, And Firewall r0.1

Status: **candidate controls; no access or execution authorized**

## Proposed `EL-G0` Boundary

If the exact Gate-0 candidate is approved, `EL-G0` may:

- inspect repository implementation and documentation read-only to identify an
  exact reproducible historical control and candidate-development seams;
- inventory non-outcome data identity and lineage information supplied through
  an owner-approved, human-mediated path;
- draft profile, population, metric, inference, candidate-family, stopping,
  resource, provenance, and later-gate decision records;
- perform static consistency checks on those records; and
- report that a required binding is unavailable or that the lane is not
  feasible.

It may not:

- modify numerical algorithms or create a prototype;
- process astronomical, injection, nuisance, development, qualification, or
  challenge data;
- build, run, benchmark, tune, rank, or select a candidate or control;
- open historical-control or candidate scientific outcomes;
- create development/qualification splits using outcome information;
- create or dispatch Stage B; or
- claim conformity, validation, achieved performance, readiness, fallback, or
  production authority.

## Repository And Change Isolation

The proposed Gate-0 working branch is
`codex/sci-fruit-v0.1-empirical-lane`, created only after approval from the
exact commit containing the accepted Gate-0 packet. The execution record must
bind the full source commit before inspection begins. Gate-0 changes are
documentation and registration artifacts only. Numerical source changes are a
stop condition.

Later development code, if `EL-GD` is approved, must be isolated from the
accepted scientific-contract bytes and identify every prototype generation.
No prototype behavior becomes scientific authority.

## Data Custody And Contamination

Development, qualification, and challenge identities are assigned and checked
by a named custodian. Qualification and protected historical-control outcomes
remain inaccessible to candidate developers until `EL-GQ`. Lineage checks
cover observations, sources, injections, nuisance realizations, descendants,
near-duplicates, and derived products.

If a protected outcome is exposed early, the event is recorded immediately;
the affected population is quarantined and is not silently reused as untouched
evidence. A replacement population requires the prospectively declared rule
and separate authority.

## Unity And Execution Boundary

Unity access remains human-mediated. Codex does not connect to, query, or run
Unity. Gate 0 may prepare a proposed inventory request or later execution plan,
but the scientific owner or an identified human operator must review and run
any Unity command under the separately approved gate. No Unity inventory,
build, reduction, or job is authorized by this packet.

## Resource And Stop Controls

Gate 0 consumes no reduction compute and no empirical storage allocation. It
ends when it produces a reviewable Gate-D packet or a typed no-go record. It
stops early on any of the following:

- exact historical-control identity cannot be made reproducible;
- protected outcomes or population membership cannot be isolated;
- candidate-neutral metrics cannot be specified before tuning;
- the requested task would require numerical code changes or empirical runs;
- role, provenance, retention, or resource ownership remains ambiguous; or
- the work would cross into an adjacent source/OOF/SZE scientific authority.

Stopping is an honest preparation result, not a failed scientific method.
